owner_decision: 2026-11-10: the owner asked for the next town with its harbour planned in from the start, rejected the first frontal concepts as too flat, chose concept C (a deep gorge seen from its right wall, the locks falling into a harbour basin) and approved painting the full Embercourt set into it.

generation.tool: imggen: OpenAI Images API, gpt-image-2.6-sunburst, masked edit, quality medium, complexity low

method: Each building is a masked edit of the empty gorge (image 1) with its box as the mask and a reference (image 2): a crop of the concept painting for the buildings the concept designed, a detail of it for style only, or the next stage's painting for earlier stages. Image 1 was a crop of the gorge around the box, scaled to the edit size, so the box filled about a third of it. The crop is centred on the box; where it ran past the frame, the gorge was mirrored at the edge for the edit, and the painting is the edit's part inside the frame, which crop records.

concept.note: Image 1 was the plot plan sketch (plan_sketch.png), image 2 the earlier Embercourt town painting, used for style and building designs only.

revisions.change: Level natural ground painted in at the plots: the buildings were each painted with a shelf of their own under them, which the layer does not keep, so on steep ground they hung over cliff faces and slopes. One unmasked edit of the backdrop, marked with a band at the foot of every plot's buildings; it is taken only near the bands, and the basin, the locks' falls and the beacons stay as they were. Plots that stand on water or on their own piles have no band (building_dev_shipyard, embercourt_t7_1). The edit was also asked for ground under the serpent pen, which stands in the basin; the blend leaves that plot out. The buildings are cut against the backdrop they were painted on (painted_on) and drawn over this one.
revisions.tool: tools/town_plot_shelves.py (marks, blend); imggen: OpenAI Images API, gpt-image-2.6-sunburst, edit without a mask with the marks as markup, quality high, complexity high. lock_gorge_shelves_keep.png is the water, falls and lamps of the effect mask at the master's size.

grounding: Painted into the empty gorge on its own plot by a masked edit; the layer is the building as BiRefNet marks it, with a short soft skirt of its painted foundation, and later stages keep the plot's ground line.
curation: Owner-approved lock-gorge set (2026-11-10); layers draw under the stage tint and light, clicks follow the building-only hit mask.

matting.input: 1024x1024, ImageNet mean and std, averaged with the mirrored window
matting.window: the building BiRefNet finds touching the plot in a first look (plot box and paint change over 70, margin 0.4), then margin 0.12, grown by 0.25 on a side the building covers over 0.02 of, at most 4 windows
matting.passes: a building with matte_passes is looked at that many times, each time with what was found (grown by 6 px) painted back to the empty backdrop, and its matte is the union
